summary.intent: Resolve 5 PR review threads for PR #372 in cipher-box, then fix a CI test failure caused by one of those fixes.
summary.outcome: All 5 review threads were addressed and resolved, 4 code fixes committed. A failing CI test was identified, fixed, and a new test added to cover the expanded behavior; 56 tests pass.

repo: ShareKeyEntryDtoKeyType already includes 'folder-ipns' — no enum addition needed when adding new key types if they're pre-existing.
Permission downgrade logic must explicitly delete both 'file-ipns' and 'folder-ipns' keys, not just one variant.
addShareKeys blocks write recipients from adding folder keys — this now covers both 'folder' and 'folder-ipns' key types.

code.finding: TextEditorDialog needs fallback file key lookup for standalone file shares where item.id equals shareId
Had a misleading comment about 'fallback to fileKeyEncrypted' that was removed for clarity
ShareKeyEntryDtoKeyType already includes 'folder-ipns'; review comment was not applicable
addShareKeys must block both 'folder' and 'folder-ipns' key types for write recipients
Permission downgrade must delete both 'file-ipns' and 'folder-ipns' keys
Test expected exact keyType 'file-ipns' but implementation now uses In(['file-ipns', 'folder-ipns']); test must use TypeORM In() matcher. Also required adding In to imports.

workflow: When changing a query from exact match to In() with TypeORM, corresponding specs must switch from literal value assertion to In() matcher.
After fixing a behavior to cover additional enum variants, check all existing tests for that behavior — they may assert the old single-value form.

friction: CI failure was not immediately obvious from the PR — required fetching job-level logs to identify the specific failing test and assertion mismatch.
The In() import was missing from the spec file and had to be added as a separate step after the test edit.
open_items: The existing 'should reject write-share recipient adding folder' test only covered keyType 'folder' — a gap that existed before this session; the new 'folder-ipns' test was added here but prior coverage was incomplete.
